slides.title: How to Structure an SGD Presentation

content.text: A non-clinical demonstration of the G5 SGD Shell renderer.

content.label: Purpose
content.text: Demonstrate the slide shell and layout engine without patient information or clinical claims.

items: What information belongs on the cover?
How should a case snapshot be summarized?
When are tables or flowcharts preferable?
How should references and take-aways be presented?

content.label: One purpose per slide
content.text: Keep each block focused on one idea. Use a short heading and concise supporting text.

content.label: Traceability
content.text: Link content to source IDs when a real case and references are supplied.

content.label: Use a table
content.text: When readers need to compare categories, findings, or options.

content.label: Use a flowchart
content.text: When readers need to follow a sequence, pathway, or decision process.

items: Keep the eight-step narrative spine in order.
Prefer editable shapes over screenshots where practical.
Preserve figure proportions and check slide boundaries.
Do not invent case facts or references.

content.text: No external clinical references are used in this non-clinical renderer demonstration.
BISTER, DEIPARINE, DATO, KANASHIRO, MONTEROSO, & TIBURON
